title: Eddie Jackson and the Tuxedo band; Harrison Bond
summary: Jackson played in the Tuxedo band with Barbarin; Harrison Bond filled in on trumpet when musicians were scarce.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: They had another Jackson play with him last month later. Another Jackson.
Tuxedo band is up now, but the different men, you know. Yeah. All the men used to play there, they all... About there.
Kind of Mark Harrison-Bonds is still going on, huh?
Very sly, huh? Mm-hmm. Yeah. He was good. He was good with him. He played anything.

Call him. Yes. Things were so bad, he couldn't get musicians. Mm-hmm. And he was playing a few more way up in the night down a little bit. And I said, who's going to eat the bass? I said, how you call him? Harrison.
So he's going to lead the band. He was supposed to play bass drum, but we couldn't get no trumpet player. So he played trumpet.
Oh, he was a good musician.
That was his original instrument, trumpet?
He played. He used to play.
He played that whenever it was needed, you know? Oh, yeah.
